headline: Ellis Island closes its doors
post_facts: Last to leave: Norwegian sailor Arne Peterssen

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in nineteen fifty-four... America's most famous front door closed.

scenes.label: New York Harbor
scenes.caption: Ellis Island, 1902
scenes.text: [warmly] Since eighteen ninety-two, Ellis Island had received newcomers to America.

scenes.label: immigrants passed through its halls
scenes.text: [softly] About twelve million immigrants passed through its halls.

scenes.label: Newcomers
scenes.caption: Italian immigrants at Ellis Island
scenes.title: The last to leave
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] The last to leave was a Norwegian sailor, Arne Peterssen.

scenes.title: Where millions of American stories began
scenes.text: [gently] For millions of families, an American story began here.

scenes.title: Did your family's story begin here?
scenes.text: [gently] Did your family's story begin at Ellis Island?
